classifier2026.identity_gate: No author-labelled EMC exposed in main roster. Source reports integrated expert histopathology/molecular diagnoses; named UPS10 and other explicit nonEMC subtype counts are source-level contrary evidence, not evidence inferred from the methylation classifier. SarcomaNOS11 remains a generic eligibility gap without individual final subtype/crosswalk. An aggregate roster alone does not permit selecting or reassigning a specific NOS case to EMC, nor claiming every such case excluded.

classifier2026.value_novelty: Published classifier calibration/performance and morphology-class comparison are original author observations; repeated platform/classification result is not a new EMC regulatory state. Different sampled treatments/materials and lack of systematic tumor content further limit native disease-region inference.

nanoDx2023.EMC_condition: SARC-05, one author-pathology EMC fresh-frozen resection. Main offers no exposedNR4A3confirmation; source diagnostic status retained with that limitation. Publishedclassifierconfidence0.88/meancoverage0.11; no new measurement discovered.
nanoDx2023.assay: Methods compute raw per-site methylated-read fraction then binarize>0.6 for classifier. Classifier votes/tSNE cannot substitute locus methylation, allele output or biological state. Global coverage0.11 neither authenticates locus depth nor establishes missing regional sites.
nanoDx2023.release: Main availability offers sarcomaREFERENCE.h5 reasonable-request, not an explicit public patient-level methylation deposit. No outreach permitted. Actual public raw/site matrices and sufficient region read depth remain pending; no assumed technical absence.
nanoDx2023.donor_overlap: Newcase/reference cohort overlap not proven or excluded; GSE140686 classifier reference reuse not independent replication.
nanoDx2023.value_novelty: Published diagnostic concordance is prior art; no measured new IG-DMR/regulatory pattern. Would need source-authenticated per-site coverage, native comparators and a frozen worthwhile assay question.
